    result = apply_discount(Decimal('10.005'), 0, True)
    assert result == Decimal('10.005')

billing.py::is_in_trial_window:3.test_code:
from datetime import date
from billing import is_in_trial_window


def test_trial_window_boundary_exact_14_days():
    # signup on Jan 1, today is exactly 14 days later (Jan 15)
    # original: today - signup < timedelta(days=14) -> 14 < 14 is False
    signup = date(2026, 1, 1)
    today = date(2026, 1, 15)
    assert is_in_trial_window(signup, today) is False
